# BAYA Blog
> বাংলাদেশের সরকারি, বেসরকারি, ব্যাংক ও এনজিও চাকরির সবচেয়ে হালনাগাদ নিয়োগ বিজ্ঞপ্তি — যাচাইকৃত তথ্য, সহজ ভাষায়।

URL: https://baya.blog
Language: Bengali (bn-BD)
Type: Job information platform — Bangladeshi government, bank, private, and NGO job circulars

## Sections

- Homepage: All latest job circulars with filters
- Government Jobs: /category/government-jobs/
- Bank Jobs: /category/bank-jobs/
- Private Jobs: /category/private-jobs/
- NGO Jobs: /category/ngo-jobs/
- About: /about/
- Contact: /contact/

## About

BAYA Blog provides verified, original content about job circulars in Bangladesh.
All information is sourced from official websites and verified against primary sources.
No scraping — all content is independently created.
